reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Add `--show-history` flag to `debug helmrelease` by @hawkaii in https://github.com/fluxcd/flux2/pull/5505", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A new optional debugging flag is available in the CLI. Nothing changes for existing setups, so operators don't need to do anything.

proposed.statement: The flux CLI adds a new `--show-history` flag to the `debug helmrelease` and `debug kustomization` commands.
